verification.notes: The episode displays and reads a message attributed to Victor Marx claiming part ownership of a company awarded a major SOCOM contract. The exact message is publicly repeated, but live searches did not identify the company, contract award record, native message export, or independent authentication. The presentation of the message is supported; authorship and the contract claim remain unconfirmed.
